text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of the "Summer 
Training Camp." Reporters swarm in, firing 
off questions comparing Narita Brian to 
Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf, however, maintains an air 
of effortless composure. Narita Brian 
burns with fighting spirit, eager to drag 
her out onto a stage of true, earnest 
competition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The air surrounding the two quietly heats 
up. And thus, the summer training camp 
begins.
